name: print-social-media-infographics-isolated-elements-abcd-hexagons-worldmap
title: 'Media Infographics — Isolated infographics elements' kit with ABCD hexagon labels and a world map diagram
whatItIs: A teal infographic kit with a red-and-navy ribbon header, a hexagon cluster labelling categories A-E, a layered donut chart with percentages, small labelled ribbon tags (Camera, News, Letters, Internet) each with an icon, and a teal world map with location pins and connecting dotted lines under an 'Infographic Map' heading.
whatItMeans: Modular and reusable; presenting infographic pieces as an 'isolated elements' kit shows the components can be mixed into new layouts.
techniques: Label categories with a hexagon cluster for quick reference.
Package chart types and icons as a reusable element kit.
Use a world map with connecting lines to show global reach.

vocabulary.definition: A set of reusable infographic pieces meant to be combined.
A world map marked with pins and connecting lines.
